Customer is treating this as a gate for FY26 platform standardization. Quote from CISO: 'We can’t do anything that looks like a multi-tenant hosted API for PHI.' They want a clean, auditable story: Private boundary, encryption/KMS, audit logging to Splunk, and a retention statement they can paste into their internal risk memo. They are OK with contract-based language on incident notification; just needs consistency.

We should be careful not to over-commit on 'zero retention' in all cases — align to the retention one-pager and distinguish (a) customer content vs (b) operational telemetry/audit logs. Also keep Hosted vs Private statements separate; OmniHealth is only evaluating Private.

Next: get NDA executed, then GRC to share SOC 2 Type II + pen test summary. Provide an audit log sample/event category list (Kevin Osei) and confirm SIEM export mechanism for Private (what’s supported today vs roadmap).
